```sql
-- name: top_products
-- owner: merchandising
-- params: tenant_id, from, to, limit
-- Best sellers by units and revenue. Line items reference the variant by its
-- string id (integration feed), so it is cast when joining the catalog.
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
filtered_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents,
           pv.id         AS variant_id,
           pv.product_id
      FROM filtered_orders fo
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = fo.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       count(DISTINCT fl.order_id)     AS order_count,
       sum(fl.quantity)                AS quantity,
       sum(fl.line_total_cents)        AS revenue_cents,
       count(DISTINCT fl.variant_id)   AS variant_count
  FROM filtered_lines fl
  JOIN products p ON p.id = fl.product_id
 GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.brand, p.currency
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orderfilter wordt eerst in een CTE uitgevoerd, zodat de regels en catalogusjoins alleen voor relevante orders plaatsvinden en de producttabel pas aan het eind wordt gejoind. De output (kolommen, aggregaten en ORDER BY) is gelijk aan het origineel. De winst is afhankelijk van de selectiviteit van de tenant- en datumfilter, en omdat er geen indexen mogen worden toegevoegd is die beperkt.
